verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official MCP server (Agentic Toolbox MCP) that lets external coding agents retrieve review findings and coding standards, and a runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP gateway is live and auth-gated (not vaporware). This directly satisfies connecting an agent via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on report of using the MCP server end-to-end, and more detail on the full tool surface exposed via MCP.
